title: Toggle
description: Buttons that stay pressed. Toggle for one (pin, mute, bold); ToggleGroup for a set of icon or short options, one or several at a time (list / grid view, text styles).
when: A view mode with icons; text formatting; a pin / follow / mute switch on a toolbar.

instead.need: Filter a list by text options
A setting saved immediately with a label

a11y: Toggle uses aria-pressed. ToggleGroup type="single" is a radio group (←/→ move and select), type="multiple" a toolbar of pressed buttons. Icon-only options need aria-label.
